acceptance_criteria: ISSUE (MAJOR, AC7): Self-contradiction in the alphabet definition. Section 4 (line ~231) defines and uses the 32-symbol alphabet '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ', which contains both L and Q -- this is the alphabet the section 4 entropy arithmetic (26x5=130 bits) and section 7 Drizzle-shape pseudocode are built on. But section 6 open question 5 (line ~358) and section 10's summary (line ~458) both assert the alphabet excludes '0/O/1/I/L' -- claiming L is already excluded, contradicting section 4's own literal alphabet string. FIX: make section 6 and section 10 match section 4 exactly -- drop the false L-exclusion claim, leave only Q named as the flagged optional exclusion (matching what section 4 actually says: 32 symbols already reached, no further exclusion needed, Q could optionally be dropped by BACKEND-DEV at the cost of moving off a clean power of two). Do NOT change section 4's alphabet itself (excluding L from the current 32 would give 31, not a power of two, breaking the exact log2 arithmetic without a compensating swap) -- the validator confirmed section 4's arithmetic is correct as written; only sections 6 and 10's prose is wrong.

After the fix, grep the artefact for the string '1/I/L' or similar false-exclusion claims and confirm zero remaining instances outside a clearly-labeled 'this was the pre-rework error' note if you choose to leave one for the record.

Every other acceptance criterion CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR already confirmed PASSing (AC1-6, AC8-9, no-implementation-code, FR-4 open question left open, FK closure precision) must remain unchanged and still true after your edit -- this is a targeted fix, not a rewrite.
